summary.method: GitHub code-search sample; exact basename .mcp.json; static MCP Drift Check classification; no MCP server execution
limitations: GitHub code search ranking is not a random sample and is capped by query/result limits.

No raw config contents, environment values, credentials, server names, or command arguments are stored.
